parameters.query: update appointment_leads set status=case when status in ('booked','suppressed') then status else 'needs_review' end,attention_reason=$2,next_contact_at=null,notes=coalesce(notes,'') || E'\nArticle delivery held until audit.example.com DNS and HTTPS are verified.',updated_at=now() where client_slug='example-client' and email=lower(trim($1));select true as held;
